title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
reason: Ledger confirming an unauthorized hardware implant in sold devices is a confirmed security breach at a major crypto infrastructure company with named sourcing.

sources.summary: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device linked to crypto losses at CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. The company says confirmed cases are limited and its internal systems remain unaffected.

title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
reason: A major global bank custodying RLUSD and linking it to LMAX collateral is a significant institutional adoption milestone, corroborated by a second outlet.

sources.summary: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.
